column7: AddProjectMember/UpdateProjectMember (POST/PUT /api/v1/projects/{id}/members) never tagged ctx with core.WithSelfMachineGranter for a machine actor before calling core.AddProjectMember/SetProjectMemberRole, so checkGranterHoldsPermission unconditionally refused any machine actor granting project membership regardless of its real roles.assign authority (authzdiff cross-layer differential harness waiver known-06, historical name D6). Fixed by tagging ctx in both handlers, mirroring the AddGroupMember fix.
